svg.text: A GNN is not one network — it is a family of tiny class- and port-specific MLPs tied to the graph.
toy example: line L (r,x) · switch S (—) · generator G (p0,q0) · load D (p,q) over addresses a0 a1 a2 · z = encoded features, h = per-address coordinate, d = latent dim

svg.text: Total for this toy use case: 3 encoder + 6 message + 1 shared φ + 2 decoder MLPs — each one small, and reused across every object / address of its kind.
